label: late original-phase steps (t>=4), content-gated by earlier q/i/0/m tokens
explanation: Fires almost only during the original-input phase at steps t>=4 (99% of activation mass; peak at orig_idx 5-6; about 1% at the delimiter; never in the copy phase or at t<3). Position is necessary but not sufficient: within that window only about 5.5% of steps are active (F1 0.10), and conditioning on to_go or L does not raise precision. Whether it fires depends on sequence content in a distributed way. It is enriched when the prefix contains q/i/0/m (first_tok q 4.9x, l 3.4x), when the current input is t (4.4x), and when the previous input is c/e/x (2.9-3.9x). Top examples look like q 0 i 0 x c t. Requiring two or more of q/i/0/m earlier in the sequence gives F1 0.23 and mass recall 0.52; ORing in prev_tok in {c,e,x} gives mass recall 0.70 at precision 0.14. No compact predicate found; behaves like a hash of the prefix contents.
